components.text: VR GOLD PANNING & RIVER CLAIM SIMULATION

components.name: TextMeshProUGUI
components.text: Use your hand shovel to scoop sand along the riverbank into your gold pan.

components.name: TextMeshProUGUI
components.text: Dip your filled pan into the running river water to wet the material.

components.name: TextMeshProUGUI
components.text: Shake your VR controller left-to-right. River current sweeps away light

components.name: TextMeshProUGUI
components.text: Dense precious gold nuggets remain at the pan's bottom. Pick & sell them!
